messages:
Noah: Heads-up: we need to reshuffle the agenda 1 - move the roadmap earlier by ~8 minutes, and slide deck has a timing mismatch with the demo. Can ops confirm recorder fallback?
Priya: Copy. I see a small encoder hiccup in the rehearsal logs, switching ingest to backup and starting the local recorder now.
OpsBot: obs-ingest switched to backup-node-2 :white_check_mark: 
Sam: Can we pause for 20s between roadmap and Q&A to allow captions catch-up? The captions drifted during the dry run.
Mia (CEO): Yes — let's add a 30s buffer and call out the Dedicated autoscaler as "planned" rather than "shipped". We'll field questions about timeline in Q&A.
Priya: Starting local capture with fallback path:
```
recorder-cli start --label allhands-mar23-2026 --dest /data/recs/allhands-mar23.mp4 --fallback backup-node-2
```
RecorderBot: Recording started: /data/recs/allhands-mar23.mp4 (id: r-9933)
Noah: Great. Priya, can you also trigger a short caption resync just before we go live?
Priya: Doing caption resync now. ETA ~15s.
Sam: I'll move the Q&A queue to the top of the moderator view and highlight pricing questions (monthly vs annual commit) and Dedicated capacity SLAs.
Mia (CEO): Good. @Product please be ready for 5-7 minutes on pricing and autoscaler plans.
Priya: Uploading the raw recording after session, will attach to INF-589.
Noah: Thanks team 1 I'll be watching the stream and will ping if we get any more drops.
Sam: Feed looks stable. Captions resynced.
RecorderBot: Upload complete: https://internal-storage/recs/allhands-mar23-2026.mp4 :rocket:
Priya: INF-589 created and will include raw file + notes.
Noah: Post-meeting tasks: Priya attach recording + INF, Sam to export 10-minute highlight clip and share, Mia to take top 3 Qs live.
Mia (CEO): Got it. Thanks everyone for the quick switch. Live in 2.
Noah: Closing thread and moving to live channel. Good luck!
